purpose: Teach: 瓩/屬/璽/錣/註/楼/个/北村

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、旧表記の瓩、つまりキログラム単位の在庫を整理しろ
lines.en: Our company needs to reorganize inventory listed in the old kilogram unit notation.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative. Measured pace with distinct separation between clauses. No softening—just clear mandate. Direct eye contact implied.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。旧字「屬」、つまり属の部署表記を新字に統一します
lines.en: Understood. I'll standardize the department notation from the old character to the new one across all records.
lines.style: Steady, respectful confirmation. Slight nod in the voice. Methodical listing of steps—showing he's already mentally organizing the task.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、公式文書の璽、つまり社印を厳重に管理しろ
lines.en: Make sure the company seal is handled with strict security protocols going forward.
lines.style: Firm, deliberate. Weight on 'strict.' Not harsh—just non-negotiable. The tone of someone who's seen what happens when security lapses.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業者寄贈の錣、つまり甲冑神具を社内展示します
lines.en: Understood. I'm also planning to display the founder's donated armor set in the office.
lines.style: Smooth pivot. Slightly lighter than the previous line—offering something constructive beyond the mandate. Confident in the decision.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、契約書の註、つまり註釈を弁護士に確認させろ
lines.en: Have the contracts reviewed by legal—especially the annotations and fine print.
lines.style: Crisp instruction. Brief pause before 'have'—emphasizing the delegation. Tone implies this is non-negotiable precision work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本社の高楼、つまり超高層ビルへ移転する案も検討します
lines.en: Understood. We're also exploring the possibility of relocating to the new high-rise headquarters.
lines.style: Even-paced update. Slight lift on 'exploring'—indicates this is forward momentum, not just compliance. Professional optimism underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、旧帳簿の个、つまり個の数え方を電子化しろ
lines.en: Digitize the old ledger counting methods and unit notations—that needs to be done systematically.
lines.style: Measured and deliberate. Slight emphasis on 'systematically.' The tone of someone ensuring nothing is left to chance or interpretation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規取引先の北村社長と会食を設定します
lines.en: Understood. I'll set up a meal meeting with the new business partner, President Kitamura.
lines.style: Brisk closing. Professional warmth—the kind that signals readiness to move forward. Slight forward energy, wrapping up the briefing.
